spans.s:
r. 1st and 6th cls. (कडति)
To be confused or disturbed by pleasure or pain, to be proud or mad, (the roots differ in some of the inflections.)
(इ) कडि r. 1st cl. (कण्डते)
The same as the preceding;
also r. 1st and 10th cls. (कण्डति, कण्डयति)
1 To break off a part, to tear, to separate or detach.
2 To remove the chaff or husk of grain, &c.
3 To preserve.

mfn. (-डः-डा-डं)
Ignorant, stupid.
E.
कड to be perplexed, अच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (कड्डति)
To be rough, to be harsh or severe: the pen. is originally द.

n. (-कं)
Sea salt obtained by evaporation.
E.
कड to separate, वुन् aff.

m. (-रः)
Straw, the stalks of various sorts of pulse, &c.
E.
कड made, कृ to make, खच् affix; also कडङ्गर.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be fed with straw.
E.
कडङ्कर, and छ affix; also with यत्, कडङ्कर्प्य; and from कडङ्ग, कडङ्गरीय.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A spirituous liquor, a kind of rum.
E.
कड to be intoxicated, अङ्ग aff.

m. (-रः)
Straw, chaff.
E.
कड, रक affix, अङ्गच् inserted.

n. (-त्रं)
A vessel.
E.
गड to distil, अत्रन् Uṇādi affix, and क substituted for ग; also कलत्र.

m. (-म्बः)
1 The stalk of a potherb.
2 The end or point.
E.
कड to separate, &c. अम्बच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-म्बी)
A potherb, (Convolvulus repens): see कलम्बी.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Tawny.
m. (-रः)
1 Tawny, (the colour.)
2 A servant.
E.
कड to be confused, आरण् aff.

m. (-लः)
A sword, a scymitar, a sacrificial knife.
